items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new spend, production work, requeues, monetization expansion, and unsupported financial forecasts. Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; it is not site-attributable. AI spend is $916.91454435 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 39 instrumented sites, including 5,009 calls and 228 errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because matching-period infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, commitments, budget ceilings, and approved learning thresholds are missing. Continue only the existing reconciliation, measurement, repair-or-close, and evidence work.

Reject vanity-metric and unsupported revenue claims. SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating indicators, not revenue or contribution-margin evidence. The 30-day scorecard generated 2026-09-28 records 3 proven outcomes and 36 improvements awaiting measurement; this does not support a portfolio forecast or causal-lift claim. Preserve the current containment plan.
